title: Get Aggregator Working End to End
description: Puzzle 3D shows only the grid. No object meshes are visible, including after dropping an object: the transform gumball appears for the selected object, but its mesh does not render. Trace the complete object-to-scene mesh path, fix the root cause, add regression coverage in existing tests, and verify runtime viewport behavior with console evidence.
summary: Aggregator works end to end on React (http://127.0.0.1:6023/, Entwerfen mit Bestand brand, Abbau Aufbau). Root cause was revealIndex JSON null plus boot cutoff 0 hiding ordinary instance roots; plugin now omits revealIndex for untagged objects and the host uses nullish guards. Live Playwright verification: seeded instance visible with rootVisible true, GLB 86112B loaded into 57 meshes with scene/root visible, Perspective viewport screenshot shows the 3D object. Regressions: vitest isRevealCutoffHidden (2 passed), cargo seeded_objects_omit_reveal_index (1 passed).
